rect.style: stroke: var(--fig-border, #e2e8f0); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.8; fill: var(--fig-panel, #f8fafc); fill-rule: evenodd;

circle.style: stroke: var(--fig-grid, #e5e9f0); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: var(--fig-muted, #64748b); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-opacity: 0.45; stroke-dasharray: 3, 2;

polygon.style: stroke: var(--fig-muted, #64748b); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.5; fill: var(--fig-muted, #64748b); fill-rule: evenodd; fill-opacity: 0.45; stroke-opacity: 0.45;
stroke: var(--fig-ink, #1e293b); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1; fill: var(--fig-ink, #1e293b); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: var(--fig-dir, #16a34a); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.5; fill: var(--fig-dir, #16a34a); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.6px;fill: var(--fig-rot, #db2777); stroke:none;
